description.value: Special Authorization SA2139. Detailed eligibility criteria available via authorization form.
Initial application - Confirmed HIV (Applications from named specialist. Approvals valid without further renewal unless notified).
Renewal - Confirmed HIV (Applications from named specialist. Approvals valid without further renewal unless notified).

expression.value: exists(Condition where code in 'TreatmentRemainsAppropriate') and exists(Condition where code in 'PatientBenefitingFromTreatment')

description.value: Initial application - Prevention of maternal transmission (Applications from named specialist. Approvals valid for 1 year).

expression.value: exists(Condition where code in 'PreventionOfMaternalFoetalTransmission') or exists(Condition where code in 'TreatmentOfNewbornUpToEightWeeks')

description.value: Initial application - pre-exposure prophylaxis following exposure to HIV (Applications from any relevant practitioner. Approvals valid for 4 weeks).

expression.value: exists(Condition where code in 'TreatmentInitiatedWithin72HoursPostExposure') and (exists(Condition where code in 'CondomlessAnalOrReceptiveVaginalIntercourseWithKnownHIVPositiveVL>200') or exists(Condition where code in 'SharedInjectingEquipmentWithKnownHIVPositive') or exists(Condition where code in 'NonConsensualIntercourseRiskAssessmentIndicatesProphylaxisAppropriate') or exists(Condition where code in 'CondomlessAnalIntercourseWithHighPrevalenceCountryOrRiskGroupStatusUnknown'))

description.value: Renewal - second or subsequent post-exposure prophylaxis (Applications from any relevant practitioner. Approvals valid for 4 weeks).

expression.value: exists(Condition where code in 'TreatmentInitiatedWithin72HoursPostExposure') and (exists(Condition where code in 'CondomlessAnalOrReceptiveVaginalIntercourseWithKnownHIVPositiveVL>200') or exists(Condition where code in 'SharedInjectingEquipmentWithKnownHIVPositive') or exists(Condition where code in 'NonConsensualIntercourseRiskAssessmentIndicatesProphylaxisAppropriate') or exists(Condition where code in 'CondomlessAnalIntercourseWithHighPrevalenceCountryOrRiskGroupStatusUnknown'))

description.value: Initial application - Percutaneous exposure (Applications from named specialist. Approvals valid for 6 weeks).
Renewal - Second or subsequent percutaneous exposure (Applications from named specialist. Approvals valid for 6 weeks).
